other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Guru applicants must be eminent practitioners/resourceful persons in the specified art field
Guru applicants must be aged between 45 and 70 years
Guru applicants must be physically and mentally sound to run the Guru‑Shishya Parampara Kendra
Shishya applicants must be aged between 15 and 25 years
Persons who have previously availed a similar scheme from the Government of India or a State Government are not eligible
Applicants must appear in person for interviews and demonstrate efficiency in the field
benefits_summary: Selected Guru receives an honorarium of Rs. 7,500 per month, with one accompanist (Rs. 3,750 per month) and four Shishyas (Rs. 1,500 per month each) appointed for a one‑year term.
